tonight.headline: Jefferson practised and is in your lineup; four other names are on Wednesday's injury reports
body: Bad news first. You are 0–4, and Wednesday's reports put four of your players on the list: Likely limited with a new knee and groin, Addison out with a hamstring, Kamara out with a back, McLaurin still not practising. Metcalf, the receiver this morning's brief told you to wait a day for, was added by Nicky Jam at 07:00.

The good news is the one that matters most. Jefferson practised, limited, for the first time since 27 Sep, and you put him in the lineup at 13:08. As set you project 122.5 against 117.5 and ESPN gives you 52%. The only change the projection still wants is McLaurin over Kamara in the flex, two points, and that waits for Friday's reports. Nothing needs doing today.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Ja'Marr Chase, their top projection at 21.9, did not practise on Wednesday and is still in the concussion protocol; Cincinnati say he is 'in the mix'. Chuba Hubbard is still in their flex on a bye at 0.0, so their 117.5 rises when they fix it. McBride 18.8, Purdy 18.0, London 16.0, Irving 15.3. Baker Mayfield is out for Irving's game on Thursday.

case.label: Your side
case.body: As set: Allen 20.1, Jefferson 18.6, Wilson 14.8, Warren 14.6, Tuten 14.0, Likely 12.9, Kamara 11.2, Fairbairn 8.5, the Vikings 7.8. Three of those nine are questionable.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jefferson or Likely missing practice on Thursday and Friday, on your side. Chase being ruled out, on theirs.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: All three kick off Sun 11:00 Mexico City · read Friday's reports · inactives 09:30
doFirst.title: Flex: McLaurin if he practises by Friday; otherwise Kamara, then Gordon
doFirst.subtitle: 13.2 against 11.2, exactly on the coin-flip line. McLaurin and Kamara both missed Wednesday's practice, and ESPN's numbers show neither. Gordon, 10.9, is the healthy one.

case.label: What the check says
case.body: As set you project 122.5; the projection lineup is 124.5. The whole 2.0 is McLaurin over Kamara in the flex. The tool prints it as a projection change and it sits exactly on the two-point line, so it gets no thesis and nothing in the decision log.

case.label: What Wednesday added
case.body: McLaurin did not practise and worked off to the side (commanders.com, 15:59; Washington Post via RotoWire). Stefon Diggs sat too, with a hamstring of his own. Jayden Daniels practised in full and is expected to start. Kamara was listed did-not-practise with a back injury, on a report estimated from a walkthrough; Heavy, paraphrasing Kellen Moore, says soreness and that Monday's knee is fine. Both items came after ESPN's projections were set.

case.label: The order
case.body: Follow the projection among whoever has practised by Friday. McLaurin first. If he has not practised, Kamara. If neither has, Gordon, who was not on Miami's report and whose coach said on Wednesday that 'He's going full speed and not stopping'. All three play at 11:00 on Sunday, so nothing locks early.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: McLaurin is active and Kamara outscores him on Sunday (archive). On a two-point gap that happens almost half the time.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · both kick off Sun 11:00 Mexico City · check inactives 09:30
doFirst.title: If Jefferson is inactive: Addison, if Addison has practised
doFirst.subtitle: You put Jefferson in at 13:08 today and he practised, limited, for the first time since 27 Sep. Do nothing now. His fallback sat out with a hamstring, so the fallback needs checking too.

case.label: Where it stands
case.body: Jefferson was limited on Wednesday with the ankle (vikings.com, 16:30); Kevin O'Connell had said he 'will be limited'. It is the first practice since the sprain. There is no game status until Friday and no insider has said whether Minnesota hold him through the Week 6 bye.

case.label: The fallback is hurt
case.body: Addison did not practise: 'Just has a little hamstring soreness... Consider it minor, if it's anything at all' (O'Connell, Bring Me The Sports, 7 Oct). He projects 11.4. If Jefferson is inactive and Addison has not practised either, McLaurin moves to the receiver slot and the flex goes to Kamara or Gordon.

case.label: Why this is unarmed
case.body: The lineup is right as it stands, 18.6 against 11.4. Both play in the same game at 11:00, so the swap can wait for the inactive list at 09:30 on Sunday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Jefferson is active and Addison outscores him on Sunday (archive). If Jefferson is inactive this card fires and the open lineup thesis closes untested.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · decide on Friday's report · Strange locks Sun 07:30 Mexico City
doFirst.title: If Likely is ruled out: add a free tight end
doFirst.subtitle: He was limited on Wednesday with a new knee and groin listing and you have nobody behind him. Do nothing today; no claim tonight.

case.label: The hole
case.body: The lineup check prints it plainly: nobody eligible on the bench. Likely's listing appeared on Wednesday afternoon (giants.com, 16:00) and nobody has reported how it happened. A limited practice usually ends in a start, and ESPN still projects 12.9.

case.label: Who is there
case.body: Juwan Johnson, 10.1, is on waivers until 01:00 Thursday and is a free agent after that if nobody claims him; he is not on the Saints' report, and his quarterback was limited with a wrapped hand. Brenton Strange, 9.7, is free: 8 targets and 95 yards on 87% of the snaps in Week 4 with every Jacksonville pass-catcher healthy, against a defence 5th against tight ends. Mark Andrews, 9.6, practised in full but Lamar Jackson did not practise. Take whichever of the three is free and projects highest on Friday.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Addison, if Jefferson has practised again and Addison has not: he is hurt, on bye in Week 6 and 7.2 under Jefferson. If Jefferson's own status is in doubt on Friday, Addison is needed and the seat is Coker's instead, which means disagreeing with an 85%-rostered market for one week. Kamara and Gordon each have an injured teammate and cannot be named.

case.label: Why not claim tonight
case.body: A claim in Chem costs no priority, but it costs a seat, and the strategy says not to carry a second tight end in a league whose flex cannot use one. One limited practice is not enough to break that. This is my judgement and it could be wrong by Friday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Likely plays and the tight end added scores more than the player dropped for him would have (archive). If Likely is not ruled out, this card never fires.

whatWentWrong.title: Metcalf was taken eleven minutes after this morning's brief said to wait
whatWentWrong.lead: Nicky Jam added DK Metcalf at 07:00 Mexico City. This morning's brief called one more day 'a small risk'. He was gone before that brief was published.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Activity log, 13:00 UTC: Nicky Jam added Metcalf and dropped Dontayvion Wicks, then added Brian Robinson Jr. and the Cowboys' defence. Bok-aneers had added Denzel Boston, the named alternative, at 06:49. Both are rostered now.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Thursday's planned move is gone, and with it the reason to treat Addison's seat as spare. That seat is now the one the third card would use, and only if Likely is ruled out.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing brings Metcalf back. The lesson is narrower: a free agent this brief wants is added the same day or not at all.

whatWentWrong.title: Four of your players are newly on Wednesday's injury reports
whatWentWrong.lead: Likely limited (knee/groin), Addison out with a hamstring, Kamara out with a back, McLaurin still not practising. ESPN's projections have not moved for any of them.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: giants.com, vikings.com, neworleanssaints.com and commanders.com, all published between 15:28 and 16:30 on Wednesday. Kamara's is an estimate from a walkthrough; Addison's coach calls his 'minor, if it's anything at all'. Jefferson, the one piece of good news, was limited.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: All three cards. The flex has two doubtful candidates and one healthy one, Jefferson's fallback is hurt, and the tight-end slot has no cover on the bench.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Thursday's reports. A limited or full session for any of the four takes his card back to a plain projection call.

worthALook.name: Brenton Strange
worthALook.lead: The free tight end behind the third card: a real role, and no use to you unless Likely sits.

case.label: The role
case.body: 7 catches on 8 targets for 95 on 87% of the snaps in Week 4 (archive; PlayerProfiler), with Brian Thomas Jr., Travis Hunter and Jakobi Meyers all playing, so no injury explains it. Targets 3, 2, 5, 8. In your other league you added him at 09:52 today and dropped him at 13:06.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: One tight-end slot, an RB/WR-only flex, and Likely projects 3.2 higher. Philadelphia allow the fifth-fewest points to tight ends in this scoring. FantasyPros advises against chasing him this week.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if Likely is ruled out or misses Thursday and Friday. Then he, Juwan Johnson and Mark Andrews are the three to choose from.

worthALook.name: Juwan Johnson
worthALook.lead: On waivers until 01:00 Thursday and the highest-projected tight end available. Not a claim.

case.label: The role
case.body: Targets 4, 8, 8 in the last three weeks for 10.6, 23.3 and 11.9 (archive). Not on the Saints' Wednesday report. Tyler Shough was limited with a wrapped left hand and says it will not limit him.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 10.1 against Likely's 12.9, with nowhere to play a second tight end. Minnesota's defence is ranked first or second for the week on three lists.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Friday, free, and only if Likely is downgraded. If someone claims him tonight, Strange and Andrews remain.

worthALook.sources: Week 2–4 archive · neworleanssaints.com · ProFootballTalk · ESPN league file

worthALook.name: Rico Dowdle
worthALook.lead: The back who takes carries from your Warren when he returns. He practised on Wednesday for the first time since Week 2.

case.label: The role
case.body: Limited on Wednesday with the toe (SteelersNow; Steelers Depot). Mike McCarthy said he 'will do more this week starting today'. With him active Warren took 56% and 55% of the carries; without him, all of them (archive).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: A handcuff to a back you start, on a roster with five backs and no free seat. He ran 15 times for 37 yards before the injury.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing makes him an add here. A full practice by Friday matters for Warren's number, not for your roster.

worthALook.sources: SteelersNow · Steelers Depot · RotoWire · Week 1–4 archive

doNotChase.name: Will Shipley
doNotChase.lead: Still the wire's biggest riser. Philadelphia signed another back on Wednesday.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Saquon Barkley did not practise and is 'unlikely to play' in London (Inquirer; RotoWire, 7 Oct); Tank Bigsby is on injured reserve.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Philadelphia signed Dameon Pierce to the 53 on Wednesday, so Shipley is no longer the only healthy back. 6 carries for 23 last week and 15 all season (archive). 10.2 is below all five of your backs, and Jacksonville allow the second-fewest standard points to running backs.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley ruled out for a month, and one of your own backs ruled out with him.

doNotChase.sources: Philadelphia Inquirer · PFT · RotoWire · Week 4 archive · FootballDB

doNotChase.name: Jaguars D/ST
doNotChase.lead: The fastest-rising free defence, 0.2 above yours.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Philadelphia in London without Barkley, DeVonta Smith or Lane Johnson, and with a rookie at right tackle after Cam Jurgens was traded on Wednesday. NBC ranks Jacksonville 1st for the week; SI, BetMGM and FTN 4th.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 8.0 against the Vikings' 7.8, and FTN ranks Minnesota 1st. Under a point is not a streaming move. Jacksonville's secondary has three injured starters and they are off in Week 7.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing this week. Next Tuesday you need a defence for Minnesota's bye, and that is when this row is read again.

doNotChase.sources: ESPN league file · NBC Sports · FTN · SI · Philadelphia Inquirer

doNotChase.name: Joe Mixon
doNotChase.lead: Still rising on the wire with no team.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Monday's reports had him joining Seattle's practice squad, and Monday's waiver columns still say so.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Seattle decided not to sign him 'following a physical' (Schefter via NFL.com); FTN on Tuesday night described a degenerative foot problem. No team since. He missed all of 2025 and has no projection.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A signing to a 53-man roster and a coach describing a role.

doNotChase.name: Malik Washington
doNotChase.lead: Carried, nothing new: target share in an offence that threw for 85 yards.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 5 catches on 5 targets for 67, 12.0 (archive); target shares of 28% and 29% in the last two weeks (Yahoo, 5 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Targets 8, 5, 10, 5 from Malik Willis, who was 9 of 17 for 85. Miami are off in Week 6, the same week as your Vikings.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Cincinnati, or a different quarterback in Miami.

doNotChase.name: Makai Lemon
doNotChase.lead: Carried: six targets with Smith out, in an offence that threw for 93 yards.

case.label: The rise
case.body: DeVonta Smith attended Wednesday's practice and did not take part (NBC Sports Philadelphia). FantasyPros: 'It's way too early to give up on Lemon'.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3 catches on 6 targets for 27, 5.7 (archive), and no more than 30 yards in any game. Darius Cooper caught both touchdowns.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets in London.

doNotChase.sources: Week 4 archive · NBC Sports Philadelphia · FantasyPros

waiverAnalysis.summary: The same four receivers clear the tool's bar as this morning, and the bar is still partly an artefact: it measures them against Coker, whose last two weeks are an injury and a missed game. Four weeks of data. Wednesday's reports changed the role reasons, not the verdict: none is a move. Nothing clears at running back or tight end.

rising.roleReason: 9 targets and two touchdowns in Week 4 after Mack Hollins left. Hollins (calf) did not practise on Wednesday: 'day by day, but I feel good' (Boston Globe, 7 Oct). A.J. Brown is eligible to come off injured reserve in Week 6 and Mike Vrabel says 'He won't be out there today... because he's not eligible'.
rising.action: WATCH — one nine-target game, with the team's best receiver eligible to return next week
rising.sources: raiders.com injury report · Boston Globe · NBC Sports

rising.name: Dohnte Meyers
rising.roleReason: 7 catches on 9 targets on 68 of 76 snaps after Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins left. Both did not practise on Wednesday (bengals.com, 16:26) and both are still 'in the mix' for Sunday. Zac Taylor: 'he's as close to Ja'Marr as we've probably had'. Cincinnati are off in Week 6.
rising.action: WATCH — the role exists only if Chase and Higgins both sit, and Friday decides that

rising.name: Khalil Shakir
rising.roleReason: 7 catches on 8 targets for 82 in the game DJ Moore left with an aggravated AC joint. Buffalo play on Monday and have published no report yet, so Moore's status is unknown; Keon Coleman is the Bill the columns prefer for the extra targets.
rising.action: WATCH — depends on Moore missing Monday night, and nothing is known until Thursday

rising.name: KC Concepcion
rising.roleReason: The steadiest of the four: a team-high 8 targets and a 100% route share in Week 4, and a listed starter. Nothing new on Wednesday; Tylan Wallace (knee) did not practise, which thins Cleveland's depth a little. The volume is real and the production is 7.6 a game.
rising.action: WATCH — a real role at 7.6 points a game, and no receiver seat is open
